description: 🐱🌙 An original pixel-art endless runner. We reverse engineered the Chrome dino game and rebuilt it as a cat on neon rooftops. Web + standalone Windows app.
readme:
# 🐱🌙 Neon Rooftops **An original pixel-art endless runner. A little cat sprints across neon rooftops at night, hopping chimneys, dishes, AC units and drones.** Play it in the browser, or grab the standalone Windows app. No install, no browser needed. ![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/kingabzpro/neon-rooftops) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-windows%20%7C%20any%20browser-blue) ![Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-zero-success) ![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/kingabzpro/neon-rooftops) ![screenshot](docs/screenshot.png)
> 🦖 **Born from reverse engineering.** We reverse engineered the original Chrome dinosaur game, pulled straight out of Chrome's own `resources.pak` on disk with [REA](https://github.com/morluto/rea), a reverse engineering toolkit, studied exactly how it ticks, then rebuilt it from scratch as this game with 100% original code and pixel art. Same soul, new cat. No Chromium assets are used or shipped here. ## 📥 Download & play 1. Go to the [latest release](../../releases/latest) 2. Grab `NeonRooftops-x.y.z-win-x64.zip` 3. Unzip, double-click **Neon Rooftops.exe** That's it. The app bundles its own engine, so nothing gets installed and no browser window opens. The exe is unsigned, so Windows may show "More info → Run anyway" once. To play in a browser instead, just open `game/index.html`. ## 🎮 Controls | Key | What it does | | --- | --- | | Space / ↑ | Start, jump. Hold for a higher jump, release early for a short hop | | ↓ | Dive while airborne | | Space / Enter / tap | Restart after a crash | ## ✨ Features - 🏃 Endless auto-run with a score counter and saved personal best (`HI`) - 📈 Difficulty ramps up: speed climbs from 6 to 13, gaps widen as you go faster - 🧱 Five hurdle types: chimney stacks (1 to 3 in a cluster), satellite dishes, wide AC units, and speed-gated drones - 🐈 Fair collisions: two-phase hitboxes, so grazing pixels won't kill you - 🌃 Living night city: parallax skylines, twinkling stars, blinking antennas - 🎉 Milestone flash every 100 points - 🪶 Zero dependencies in the game itself, one HTML file + one JS file ## 🔬 How it was made The Chrome dino game ships compressed inside Chrome's `resources.pak`. We extracted it, mapped the whole engine statically with [REA](https://github.com/morluto/rea) (11,944 code nodes), and pulled out every formula and constant. Then we re-implemented them with original art. ```mermaid flowchart LR A["Chrome 155 on disk
resources.pak"] -->|"resource 40019
gzipped"| B["offline.js
the hidden dino engine"] B -->|"REA static analysis
11,944 nodes mapped"| C["mechanics recovered:
jump physics, gap formula,
scoring, collision boxes"] C -->|"rebuilt from scratch
original code + art"| D["game/game.js
Neon Rooftops"] D -->|"electron-packager"| E["Neon Rooftops.exe"] E -->|"GitHub Actions on tag"| F["release .zip
one click away"] ``` ## 🔄 How the game works ```mermaid flowchart TD IN["Space / tap pressed"] --> JUMP["jump starts:
velocity scales with speed"] LOOP["update loop, 60 fps"] --> PHYS["gravity pulls the cat down
hold = higher, release = shorter"] PHYS --> MOVE["obstacles scroll left
new ones spawn by gap formula"] MOVE --> HIT{"two-phase
box collision"} HIT -->|"clean"| SCORE["score = distance x 0.025
speed slowly rises"] SCORE --> LOOP HIT -->|"crash"| OVER["game over,
save HI score"] OVER -->|"Space / Enter / tap"| LOOP ``` ## 🛠️ Development ```bash # run the 9-group self-test (physics, gaps, collision, spawns, restart) node game/game.js # desktop app: dev mode and Windows build cd desktop npm install npm start # dev npm run build # -> dist/Neon Rooftops-win32-x64/Neon Rooftops.exe ``` Pushing a `v*` tag makes GitHub Actions build and publish a release automatically. ## 📄 License [MIT](LICENSE). Original code and art. Not affiliated with Google or the Chrome team. We just took their dino apart to learn from it, then let the cat out.
